summary: Change Context for add-reservation-lookup is checkable at intake density: all eight required headings are present; nfr.json covers the six qualities with thresholds/measurement for every in_scope item and §4 projects it without contradiction; §5 inherits TypeScript/OpenAPI/OCL/Vitest as repo_existing/user with alternatives and rationale; §2/§8 list prior Features and out_of_scope still in force; §7 deferrals are non-blocking; human_gate.required false matches a user-settled additive get-by-id (opaque-principal authZ extension, no blocking open questions).
